## History

Gertie Pye is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. She attends class alongside the other local children and wears fashionable clothing with puffed sleeves, contrasting with Anne's plain dresses prior to [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas).
